titleText: JTF News: Deutsche Welle, CBC News
mainText: A Russian strike hit an ammunition depot near Kyiv, resulting in dozens of deaths.
At least 27 people are dead and hundreds evacuated following strikes near Kyiv.
Gunfire and explosions are reported in Niamey, Niger.
Flooding in Nepal and Tibet has resulted in at least 580 deaths and approximately 2,500 people missing.
King Harald of Norway died; Crown Prince Haakon ascended to the throne.
